headline: Moderate to heavy rainfall exceeding 20 mm within 24 hours is anticipated over the counties in Coast, Northeastern, Highlands West and East of the Rift Valley,
description: Moderate to heavy rainfall exceeding 20 mm within 24 hours is expected from 24th to 28th October 2026, with peak intensity between 26th and 28th October, with rainfall intensity projected to decrease by 30th October 2026.
instruction: Residents in all the mentioned areas should remain vigilant for potential flash floods and poor visibility. Note that flood waters may occur in areas where it has not rained heavily, particularly downstream. To ensure safety residents are advised to avoid shelter under trees or near grilled windows to minimize exposure to lightning strikes, Avoid crossing flooded roads and swollen rivers, stay away from drainage channels, exercise caution when travelling, and follow official weather updates. Move to safer ground if flooding occurs.

headline: Ocean wave heights exceeding 2 meters are expected on Sunday 25th October 2026
description: Ocean wave heights exceeding 2 metres are expected along the Kenyan coast on Sunday, 25 October 2026.
instruction: Residents in all the mentioned areas should remain vigilant and avoid venturing into rough seas, suspend non-essential boat trips and fishing activities, secure boats and marine equipment, and keep away from exposed shorelines. Follow official marine weather updates and heed safety instructions from relevant authorities.

headline: Strong southerly to southeasterly winds exceeding 25 knots (12.5 m/s) over coastal, eastern and northern
description: Strong southerly to southeasterly winds exceeding 25 knots (12.5 m/s) are expected over coastal, eastern and northern regions of the country from 24th to 28th October 2026, accompanied by moderate to heavy rainfall in several areas.
instruction: Residents in all the mentioned areas should remain vigilant , secure loose objects, avoid unnecessary outdoor activities, exercise caution when travelling, and keep away from trees, unstable structures and power lines. Follow official weather updates. Report any emergencies or wind-related damage to the relevant authorities.

headline: Heavy Rainfall Advisory
description:
The rainfall being experienced over several parts of the Highlands West and East of the 
Rift Valley, and Central Highlands including parts of the Southeastern Lowlands is expected 
to intensify to more than 20mm in 24 hours, from 8th to 14th May 2026. The intensity is 
expected to peak between 10th and 13th May 2026 and spread to parts of the Northwestern 
sector. The heavy rainfall is anticipated to decrease in intensity from 14th May 2026. 
Although the intensity may reduce toward the end of this period, rainfall is still expected 
to continue in the Lake Victoria Basin, Highlands West of the Rift Valley, the Rift Valley, 
Highlands East of the Rift Valley and Central Highlands (including Nairobi).
instruction:
Please remain vigilant for potential floods, flash floods, and poor visibility. Note that 
flooding may occur even in areas without heavy rainfall, particularly downstream. To 
ensure your safety, please follow these precautions: Avoid driving or walking through 
moving water or open fields; Do not seek shelter under trees or near grilled windows to 
minimize the risk of lightning strikes; Those in landslide-prone areas, especially along the 
slopes of the Aberdare Ranges, Mt. Kenya, and other hilly regions, should exercise 
extreme caution. Updates will be provided promptly if there are any changes.
